Amendment box marked No. Office field again reads 'County Commissioner' with no seat letter. Address and signature redacted upstream by the county, so residence_city is ''. notes: MULTI-REPORT BUNDLE: this single PDF contains TWO separate reports (two covers, two summary pages) - a 7-days-before-Primary report dated 4/11/24 on pages 5-9 and a 30-days-after-withdrawal report dated 5/7/24 on pages 1-4, i.e. the LATER report is filed first in the PDF.
